intent: A single yes/no poll. State is exactly {question: string, options: {yes: number, no: number}, open: boolean}. An app minted with no seed state behaves as if question is "" and options is {yes: 0, no: 0}; every verb normalizes a missing options or open field the first time it runs, treating an unset open as true (open by default) so a freshly minted poll accepts votes immediately. vote({option: "yes" or "no"}) is public: if the poll is closed (open is false) it does not change state and returns {ok: false, reason: string} explaining why; otherwise it increments options[option] by one and returns {ok: true, options} with the tally after the vote. close() is owner-only: it sets open to false, after which every vote call returns {ok:false, reason} without changing the tally; it returns true. reopen() is owner-only: it sets open back to true so votes are accepted again; it returns true. The question text itself is set by the owner when minting or seeding state (via PUT /state) and no verb changes it; a face should display state.question as-is.

vote.description: Cast one vote for "yes" or "no". Rejected without changing state if the poll is closed.
vote.code: ctx.state.options = ctx.state.options ?? { yes: 0, no: 0 }; if (ctx.state.open === undefined) ctx.state.open = true; if (!ctx.state.open) return { ok: false, reason: "poll is closed" }; ctx.state.options[ctx.input.option] = (ctx.state.options[ctx.input.option] ?? 0) + 1; return { ok: true, options: ctx.state.options };

close.description: Close the poll so no further votes are accepted. Owner only.

reopen.description: Reopen the poll so votes are accepted again. Owner only.
